result.reason: The redline reduces Customer’s notice period to 30 days and retains annual automatic renewals, satisfying the notice-window aspect of the preferred position. However, it includes neither the required 60-day Vendor renewal reminder nor any cap on price increases. Because even the fallback requires price increases to be capped at 5%, the operative language does not reach the playbook position. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the unrelated termination provisions, although the wording conflates mid-term convenience termination during a renewal term with an election not to renew.
